items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: William Walker is mentioned by the INTERVIEWER, but the INTERVIEWEE does not respond to or acknowledge this mention, instead shifting the topic to blues singers.

ctx.x: Butterbeens and Susie was big. Male and female. Male and male.
Mostly a man and his wife. Yeah. William Walker. Yeah. William Walker. Yeah, William Walker. Did you see Burt Williams ever? That's a man I did when they did. Yeah. He probably didn't get back to.

How about the blues singers? Did they used to come around here? Blue singers like Bessie Smith or Ma Rainey? Ma Rainey? Not here? Ma Rainey or who else? Clara Smith. I can't speak back to you all. It wasn't one time. That's all you could hear was the blues. Look at everybody singing. One time? That's all you could hear. Yeah. Going to any of them little places.
